Description:en: Indicator reporting (MAL-001, MAL-016). Drug concepts whose orders count as first-line malaria treatment (ACT). Empty until ACT products are added to the formulary (LE-347).

Indicator reporting (RMNCAH-021). Drug concepts whose orders count as pneumonia treatment: amoxicillin, amoxicillin-clavulanate and co-trimoxazole, per the feasibility matrix. The national guideline list is still to be confirmed.
Indicator reporting (NCD-009). Drug concepts whose orders count as diabetes treatment: insulins, glimepiride and metformin. Metformin and glibenclamide are not in the formulary yet (LE-347).
Indicator reporting (NCD-017). Drug concepts whose orders count as palliative strong-opioid treatment: fentanyl and morphine. Morphine is not in the formulary yet (LE-347).
Indicator reporting (RMNCAH-018). Drug concepts whose orders count as oral rehydration for diarrhoea: ORS and oral rehydration therapy. Zinc is not in the formulary yet.
